description: This Java class implements the ImageWritePlatformService interface, providing methods to save, update, and delete images associated with clients and staff within the Fineract platform. It manages image storage via ContentRepository and handles database updates for Image entities.

classes.name: ImageWritePlatformServiceJpaRepositoryImpl
classes.description: Implementation of ImageWritePlatformService for managing images related to clients and staff, including saving, updating, and deleting images, with storage handled via ContentRepository.

methods.name: saveOrUpdateImage
methods.description: Saves or updates an image for a specified entity (client or staff) using an InputStream.

methods.name: saveOrUpdateImage
methods.description: Saves or updates an image for a specified entity (client or staff) using a Base64EncodedImage.

methods.name: deleteImage
methods.description: Deletes an image associated with a client or staff entity.

methods.name: deletePreviousImage
methods.description: Deletes the previous image of an entity if it exists.

methods.name: updateImage
methods.description: Associates a new image with an entity and saves it.

methods.name: createImage
methods.description: Creates or updates an Image object with new location and storage type.
